name: check
summary: Validate documents against the schema, references and prefabs
usage: ara check [OPTIONS] [FILES]...

args.name: [FILES]...
args.doc: Documents to check (default: every project document)

options.name: --fix
options.doc: Apply every diagnostic's fix when it has exactly one (renames, values), then check again

options.name: --root <ROOT>
options.doc: Project root (default: the nearest ancestor with ara.project.json)

options.name: --author <AUTHOR>
options.doc: Who protocol commands are attributed to: human or agent:<name> (default: ARA_AUTHOR, else the agent running this CLI, else human)
